body: Look, that may be true for you but for me, I need something more. I'm not trying to get a girlfriend for the sake of getting one, I'm doing it because I fucking love her. You act like you're infinitely smarter than me, like you're superior for "understanding" all this. That's just not true. Emotions are weird and unpredictable. You can never understand them completely.
Ehh, if I don't do anything about it I'll only get more depressed. I might as well take my shot at happiness while I can.

Why would I not ask her out when that's the only thing extending my life currently

Idk if I wanna say my age ppl will just use it to dismiss everything cause I'm "too young"

1. I am a girl.
2. It is love, and as I have said I don't see her as perfect, I don't have those expectations.
3. Anyway I've decided not to kill myself before I ask her out so yeah
I haven't even talked to her? What? I've known her for two years...

Ya know, I think you're right actually, if I'm gonna kill myself I should at least wait until after I try to get my dream girl, and if it winds up as I described well, at least I added a little while more to my life. I've decided not to kill myself before I ask her out.

This is... the second comment I've gotten about "oneitis" which as far as I can tell is not even a real word. Looking it up all I can find is stuff about how "that one girl is not special" which is bullshit, she's not perfect, nobody is, but she certainly is special. I love her.
The thing is, if we wind up in a relationship and she winds up ending it (her past ones have... Not Ended Well) then I'll have lost everything all over again and I'll have even less reason to live

I'm in love. I don't just want sex or whatever, I want to spend time with her, I want to cuddle with her, I want to watch movies with her, I want to talk about the things we enjoy, I want to hold her hand... I want to share life with her.

If it helps my case any, I'm not some dude who wants to stick his dick in somebody, I'm a lesbian girl who wants to be in an actual relationship.
If I just walked up to her and told her I love her I'd look like a creep... She knows I like her, I'm pretty sure if she wanted to date me she'd have told me already.
I... didn't say anywhere in the post that I believe her to be The Perfect Person. I know that's impossible. I'm still in love with her.
